device.modelDescription: A module whose call the runtime refuses, and which then crashes.

actionList.name: refusedThenThrow
actionList.description: Calls compose-callee, which the runtime refuses once it is unloaded, then throws an untyped error.

actionList.name: throwsAlone
actionList.description: Throws an untyped error, calling nothing, its text a refusal's words.
